items.name: Potion
items.description: Restores a small amount of health.

items.name: Mega Potion
items.description: Restores a moderate amount of health.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A cure for poison.

items.name: Max Potion
items.description: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health Gauge.

items.name: Ancient Potion
items.description: Fully restores health and temporarily maximizes the size of your Health and Stamina Gauges.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

items.name: Ration
items.description: Food that restores a bit of stamina. It can also be used on the Portable BBQ Grill to have a meal.

items.name: Well-done Steak
items.description: A hearty roast that restores health and stamina and boosts both their max gauges. So tasty!

items.name: Rare Steak
items.description: Restores health and stamina and moderately increases the size of your Health Gauge temporarily.

items.name: Burnt Meat
items.description: Restores stamina, but it may be a bit too charred to provide any healing effects...

items.name: Lifepowder
items.description: Produces a cloud that heals you and anyone nearby.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Meat carved from a monster. Can be cooked, combined,  or used to set a trap.

items.name: Barrel Bomb
items.description: A small time bomb.

items.name: Large Barrel Bomb
items.description: A bomb that can be rolled after placing it on the ground. Strike it to trigger a powerful blast.

items.name: Flash Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that causes a violent flash on impact. Will temporarily blind monsters if used in front of them.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to hit faraway plant life and bombs.

items.name: Capture Net
items.description: A net that can be fired from your Slinger. Use it to capture small creatures.

items.name: Pitfall Trap
items.description: A trap for catching large monsters. It is tripped by heavy weight.

items.name: Shock Trap
items.description: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description: A standard-sized whetstone. Use it to restore a weapon's sharpness.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: A tool that magnifies distant objects and lets you learn more about them.

items.name: Camping Kit
items.description: A kit with all the tools to make camp. Use to set up and edit Pop-up Camps in available campsites.

items.name: Portable BBQ Grill
items.description: A portable BBQ grill that can be used for grilling up raw meat and other ingredients.

items.name: Herb
items.description: A primary ingredient in potions.

items.name: Antidote Herb
items.description: A primary ingredient in antidotes.

items.name: Honey
items.description: Highly nutritious honey. Combine with potions to make the more potent mega potion.

items.name: Bitterbug Broth
items.description: Bitterbug essence that has innate healing abilities. Used as a component in many medicines.

items.name: Flashbug Phosphor
items.description: Luminous essence from an insect that emits a powerful flash when it dies. Used to craft flash pods.

items.name: Godbug Essence
items.description: Essence from an insect said to live a millennium. Combine it with other items to add their properties.

items.name: Thunderbug Capacitor
items.description: Substance from an insect that emits electricity when struck. Required to craft Shock Traps and Thunder Ammo.

items.name: Doshaguma Hide
items.description: A Doshaguma hide. The numerous scars on its body are proof of its beastly, aggressive nature.

items.name: Doshaguma Fur
items.description: Doshaguma fur. It makes a durable crafting material thanks to its stiff, bristly texture.

items.name: Doshaguma Claw
items.description: A Doshaguma claw. Sharp as it is tough, it can cut through muscled prey without a single chip.

items.name: Doshaguma Fang
items.description: A Doshaguma fang. They grow large and sharp so they can pierce their prey with ease.

items.name: Beast Gem
items.description: A valuable jewel formed from coagulated juices inside a monster. Glows wildly.

items.name: Normal Ammo
items.description: Standard ammo. Fires multiple shots with each pull of the trigger. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Pierce Ammo
items.description: Armor-piercing ammo. Depending on the monster, it can deal multiple hits. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Spread Ammo
items.description: Ammo made for close combat. Short range but high power. Unlimited capacity.

items.name: Sticky Ammo
items.description: Powerful ammo that lodges in a target and explodes. Headshots stun.

items.name: Cluster Bomb
items.description: Ammo that fragments into multiple shells upon impact. Beware of friendly fire!

items.name: Flaming Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to fire.

items.name: Water Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to water.

items.name: Thunder Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to thunder.

items.name: Freeze Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters susceptible to ice.

items.name: Dragon Ammo
items.description: Ammo that packs a punch against monsters weak to dragon.

items.name: Poison Ammo
items.description: Ammo that inflicts poison. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Paralysis Ammo
items.description: Ammo that causes paralysis. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Sleep Ammo
items.description: Ammo that induces sleep. Some targets require multiple shots in order for the status to take effect.

items.name: Slicing Ammo
items.description: Ammo that ejects sharp blades on impact, which can sever tails.

items.name: Thorngrass Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that lodges into a target. Attacking where it's lodged deals extra damage.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Ore that can be smelted into a multi-purpose metal.

items.name: Machalite Ore
items.description: Ore mined from mineral veins. Refined Machalite Steel is far sturdier than its iron cousin.

items.name: Dragonite Ore
items.description: Ore sourced from mining outcrops. A rare material coveted for its durability in armor crafting.

items.name: Carbalite Ore
items.description: Ore obtained from mining outcrops. Still under research, but known to yield highly pure metal.

items.name: Earth Crystal
items.description: Crystallized microbes sourced from mining outcrops. Coveted as an abrasive for polishing equipment.

items.name: Mystery Bone
items.description: A weathered bone taken from a bonepile. Erosion has left it too fragile to use in crafting.

items.name: Sturdy Bone
items.description: A rigid bone taken from a bonepile. Durable but light and easy to handle.

items.name: Brute Bone
items.description: A sturdy bone from a beast. Easy to use in crafting.

items.name: Colossal Bone
items.description: A massive bone from a beast. Carefully cut out and used for crafting.

items.name: Dragonbone Relic
items.description: A high-quality bone taken from a bonepile. The remains of a dragon that once roamed these lands.

items.name: Mandragora
items.description: A dangerous fungus said to draw the life out of people. Required to craft immunizers and max potions.

items.name: Blue Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom infused with power-enhancing effects. Used in restorative items.

items.name: Burst Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that detonates on impact. Use it to stagger a monster when you're in a pinch.

items.name: Screamer Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that emits a harsh, high-frequency sound that can disrupt sensitive monsters.

items.name: Bleeding Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to inflict massive damage on monster wounds.

items.name: Dung Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that releases a strong odor on impact. Causes certain monsters to flee.

items.name: Trap Tool
items.description: A must-have item for putting together pitfall traps and shock traps.

items.name: Exciteshroom
items.description: Has a very strange aroma. Is it edible? Is it deadly? Required to make farcasters.

items.name: Smokenut
items.description: A nut that produces torrents of smoke. Combine with other items to add more effects.

items.name: Ivy
items.description: A lightweight and extremely strong plant. Used to make nets for pitfall traps.

items.name: Farcaster
items.description: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Can also be used during combat.

items.name: Balahara Shell
items.description: A Balahara shell. The fulgurite it has absorbed enhances its hardness.

items.name: Balahara Scale
items.description: A Balahara scale. The erosion caused by constant digging limits its usefulness in crafting.

items.name: Balahara Skull
items.description: The skull of a Balahara. Stronger than most, it's built to withstand harsh dives into sand.

items.name: Balahara Tail
items.description: A Balahara tail. Its unique, twisted shape allows it to propel itself through earth with great force.

items.name: Chatacabra Jaw
items.description: The mandible plating of a Chatacabra. Hard protrusions stud the thick but supple leather.

items.name: Chatacabra Hide
items.description: The thick hide of a Chatacabra. Elastic and easy to mold thanks to the monster's gluttonous diet.

items.name: Chatacabra Shell
items.description: Plating that covers a Chatacabra's forelimbs. A lifetime of licking has left it both smooth and sturdy.

items.name: Chatacabra Scale
items.description: A jagged scale from a Chatacabra's hide, especially tough and well suited for use in crafting armor.

items.name: Quematrice Scale
items.description: The scale of a Quematrice. Its fine texture acts as a natural file used to grind and polish armor.

items.name: Quematrice Hide
items.description: The hide of a Quematrice. Quite thick despite its wrinkly form, it is highly resistant to fire.

items.name: Quematrice Crest
items.description: The crest of a Quematrice. Its flamboyant red color serves as a decoy to would-be predators.

items.name: Quematrice Tail
items.description: The tail of a Quematrice. Its many pleats scrape against each other to create sparks.

items.name: Wyvern Gem
items.description: Throughout a wyvern's life, impurities gather and form this peculiar gem.

items.name: Herbivore Shell
items.description: Part of a shell taken from an herbivore. Relatively sturdy for a small monster material.

items.name: Bulaqchi Shell
items.description: A Bulaqchi shell. Great for crafting thanks to its advanced durability and light weight.

items.name: Talioth Scale
items.description: A Talioth scale. Conditioned in harsh environments, it is built to protect the body like armor.

items.name: Sharp Fang
items.description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. Choose the right fang for the job.

items.name: Wingdrake Hide
items.description: A material carved from wingdrakes. Lightweight and often used when crafting armor.

items.name: Acute Fang
items.description: Fangs come in many shapes and sizes. This one is small but can still pierce scale.

items.name: Dung
items.description: Its eye-watering stench makes useful Slinger ammo.

items.name: Rolled-up Dung
items.description: A ball of condensed monster dung. Used to make dung pods for your Slinger.

items.name: Rathian Scale+
items.description: A superior Rathian scale. Looks like a normal Rathian scale but is much harder.

items.name: Rathian Carapace
items.description: Rathian carapace prized for its lavish green coloration. An excellent armor material.

items.name: Rathian Webbing
items.description: A quality Rathian wing membrane. This heat-resistant material is often used as armor lining.

items.name: Rathian Spike+
items.description: Rathian hairs, keen as a sword. Longer and sturdier than normal, they also contain more poison.

items.name: Rathian Ruby
items.description: A rare, precious gem from inside a Rathian. Almost too nice to use.

items.name: Toadstool
items.description: A mushroom with poison properties. Needed to craft Poison Ammo and smoke bombs.

items.name: Parashroom
items.description: A mushroom that induces paralysis. Needed to craft Paralysis Ammo and tranq bombs.

items.name: Sleep Herb
items.description: A plant containing sleeping agents. Needed to craft Sleep Ammo and tranq bombs.

items.name: Fire Herb
items.description: A wondrous, flammable plant. Useful for crafting explosives and Flaming Ammo.

items.name: Flowfern
items.description: This plant's leaves store a great amount of water. A component for making Water Ammo.

items.name: Snow Herb
items.description: A plant that radiates ice-cold air. Use in combinations to create Freeze Ammo.

items.name: Dragonfell Berry
items.description: A mysterious berry rumored for eons to be loathed by dragons. Required to craft Dragon Ammo.

items.name: First-aid Med
items.description: Restores a small amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Ration
items.description: Restores a small amount of stamina. Not usable with Portable BBQ Grill. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Flash Bomb
items.description: Slinger ammo that explodes with a bright flash after it's fired. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Shock Trap
items.description: A trap that immobilizes a target. Use it to capture monsters. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Pitfall Trap
items.description: Activates a pitfall to catch monsters with. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Gloamgrass Bud
items.description: A plant with healing properties. Combine with Godbug essence to unleash its true potential.

items.name: Might Seed
items.description: Temporarily strengthens your attacks when ingested by improving energy flow.

items.name: Adamant Seed
items.description: Temporarily raises your defense when ingested by hardening tissue.

items.name: Nitroshroom
items.description: A hard-to-find mushroom with the power to generate blazing heat. Required to craft gunpowder.

items.name: Devil's Blight
items.description: A very rare fungus that pulses with extreme heat. Add to a barrel bomb for a dramatically stronger blast.

items.name: Blastnut
items.description: A nut that explodes its hard contents on impact. Used to make Sticky Ammo.

items.name: Slashberry
items.description: A berry that shatters into razor-like pieces. Used to make Slicing Ammo.

items.name: Rey Dau Scale
items.description: A Rey Dau scale. Its unique shape allows electricity from its organs to pass through.

items.name: Rey Dau Shell
items.description: The shell from a Rey Dau. Highly conductive and capable of producing large electrical currents.

items.name: Rey Dau Thunderhorn
items.description: An electrically charged Rey Dau horn. The thick, flexible muscle at its base lets it move freely.

items.name: Rey Dau Wingtalon
items.description: The claw-shaped energy conduit of a Rey Dau. Coated in sharp fulgurite blades formed by electric discharges.

items.name: Rey Dau Tail
items.description: A Rey Dau tail. Its fulgurite-covered spines rub together to produce a threatening melody.

items.name: Rey Dau Plate
items.description: A Rey Dau plate. The backward-facing scale accumulates a massive amount of energy.

items.name: Tranq Blade
items.description: A knife coated with a tranquilizer that can be shot from your Slinger to put trapped monsters to sleep.

items.name: Poison Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting poison on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Paralysis Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting paralysis on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Sleep Knife
items.description: A knife fired with the Slinger, inflicting sleep on a target. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Creates a large cloud of smoke when thrown against the ground that can hide you from a monster's sight.

items.name: Powercharm
items.description: An amulet that strengthens attacks. Just carrying this gives you demonic strength.

items.name: Armorcharm
items.description: An amulet that increases defense. Just carrying this makes your skin stone hard.

items.name: Wyvern Ammo
items.description: Ammo created through years of research into Wyvern's Fire. Short ranged, but destructive.

items.name: Grounding Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can dissipate electricity from the area it lands.

items.name: Mystery Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with faint power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.name: Glowing Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with hidden power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.name: Ancient Orb - Armor
items.description: A sphere with incredible power that is revealed through appraisal. Becomes a defensive decoration.

items.description: An old, damaged weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Rusted Weapon Shard
items.description: An old, rusted weapon part. Needs to be appraised.

items.name: Ghillie Mantle
items.description: Temporarily conceal yourself from view. The effect ends if you perform an attack or take damage.

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.description: A tool for fishing. Cast the lure into bodies of water and use the reel to wind in the line.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

items.name: Dash Juice
items.description: Recovers stamina and also temporarily reduces stamina depletion when performing actions.

items.name: Immunizer
items.description: Temporarily boosts your natural ability to recover lost health.

items.name: Cool Drink
items.description: Provides temporary relief from extreme heat.

items.name: Hot Drink
items.description: Provides temporary relief from extreme cold.

items.description: Temporarily boosts your attack power by filling you with demonic strength.

items.name: Might Pill
items.description: Temporarily endows you with the strength of a mighty god. Potent!

items.name: Mega Demondrug
items.description: Temporarily boosts your attack power even more than a regular Demondrug.

items.name: Armorskin
items.description: Temporarily boosts your defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

items.name: Adamant Pill
items.description: Temporarily makes your skin as hard as adamant. Potent!

items.name: Mega Armorskin
items.description: Temporarily boosts your defense even more than regular Armorskin.

items.name: Herbal Medicine
items.description: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of health.

items.name: Herbal Powder
items.description: Produces a cloud that cures poison and heals you a bit.

items.name: Hardshell Powder
items.description: A mysterious powder; when dispersed, temporarily strengthens defense.

items.name: Dust of Life
items.description: Produces a cloud that restores a large amount of health for you and anyone nearby.

items.name: Cleanser
items.description: Immediately removes any frost or webbing on your body.

items.name: Poison Smoke Bomb
items.description: Releases a cloud of toxic mist when used. Also popular as a household bug bomb.

items.name: Tranq Bomb
items.description: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Can be slammed against the ground.

items.description: A knife that can be equipped to your Slinger. Can be coated with a range of substances.

items.name: Poison Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that inflicts  poison on a target upon  impact.

items.name: Para Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that inflicts paralysis on a target upon impact.

items.name: Drugged Meat
items.description: Raw meat that puts whatever eats it to sleep. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: Brightmoss
items.description: Slinger ammo that illuminates dark areas when fired and can dazzle flying monsters.

items.name: Torch Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to scare away creatures that don't like fire and draw in those that do.

items.name: Puddle Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo imbued with water element. Can remove some statuses on monsters.

items.name: Bomb Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that explodes on impact.

items.description: Slinger ammo that deals piercing damage on impact.

items.name: Paint Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that makes a monster or location temporarily easier to find.

items.name: Luring Pod
items.description: Slinger ammo that can be used to lure monsters toward yourself.

items.description: Cures poison and restores a bit of health for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.description: Temporarily strengthens attacks for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Hardshell Powder
items.description: Temporarily increases defense for everyone nearby. Returned after quest completion.

items.description: Releases a cloud that restores a large amount of health. Returned after quest completion.

items.description: A hand grenade used to capture monsters ensnared in traps. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Dung Pod
items.description: Releases a strong odor on impact. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Sonic Bomb
items.description: Slinger ammo that emits an earsplitting sonic blast. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Tinged Meat
items.description: Raw meat that paralyzes whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: EZ Large Barrel Bomb
items.description: An improved large barrel bomb. Can be rolled after being placed. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: EZ Farcaster
items.description: Call for a wingdrake to transport you to the nearest camp. Returned after quest completion.

items.name: Poisoned Meat
items.description: Raw meat that poisons whatever eats it. Makes great bait for traps.

items.name: Deodorant
items.description: Produces a cloud of cleansing smoke that cures blastblight and stench.

items.name: Kunafa Cheese
items.description: An artisan cheese made in Kunafa, deliciously gooey when heated, and a great addition to any dish.

items.name: Sharp Kunafa Cheese
items.description: A rich, decadent cheese made by skilled craftspeople. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Droolshroom
items.description: A mushroom that grows in a secret spot known only to Wudwuds. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Delishroom
items.description: An extremely rare delicacy that is cause for a Wudwud celebration. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Mud Shrimp
items.description: A nutritious shrimp native to Oilwell Basin and favored in Azuz. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Turbid Shrimp
items.description: A large, chewy shrimp packed to the gills with nutrients. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Fluffy Egg
items.description: An egg with a yolk and white as fluffy as the Downy Crake that laid it. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Airy Egg
items.description: A high-quality egg that sends you straight to flavor heaven. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Sild Garlic
items.description: A highly nutritious and fragrant bulb of garlic grown in Sild. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Specialty Sild Garlic
items.description: The ultimate bulb of garlic, grown in just the right conditions. A great addition to any dish.

items.name: Wild Herb
items.description: This herb's refreshing aroma can mask any foul odor. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Eastern Honey
items.description: Has a unique flavor, making it the perfect secret ingredient. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Monster Chili
items.description: A powerful spice that enhances flavor and sweat production. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Jeweled Mullet Roe
items.description: These fish eggs truly shine like diamonds. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Wild Seed Oil
items.description: Oil that packs both flavor and the power of nature. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Truffle Du Conga
items.description: Often dug up by its namesake, Congalala. A great finishing touch to any dish.

items.name: Sinister Cloth
items.description: Suspicious cloth found somewhere in the Windward Plains. Drips with an aura of pure evil.

items.name: Great Hornfly
items.description: Found in the Scarlet Forest. An insect with a giant horn, huge shell, and butterfly wings.

items.name: Windward Aloe
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. The water stored within its plump leaves has saved many a parched traveler.

items.name: Fine Windward Aloe
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A single drop of its delicious sap transforms water into ambrosia.

items.name: Great Windward Aloe
items.description: A treasure of the Windward Plains. Its leaves hold enough water to fill a bath in the driest desert.

items.name: Sandpepper
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. This dried spice lends a rich and aromatic heat to any dish.

items.name: Fiery Sandpepper
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. A spice so hot that a single bite opens the taster's third eye.

items.name: Fulgurite Shard
items.description: Found in the Windward Plains. The shape of this fulgurite was sculpted by a chance lightning strike.

items.name: Pure Fulgurite
items.description: A rarity from the Windward Plains. Crystallized fulgurite, free of any impurity. Extremely delicate.

items.name: Thundering Fulgurite
items.description: A treasure of the Windward Plains. A colossal fulgurite crystal, born of a sky-splitting thunderstrike.

items.name: Scarlet Amber Shard
items.description: Amber from the Scarlet Forest. The bodies of fossilized insects float in its scarlet confines.

items.name: Fine Scarlet Amber
items.description: Rare amber from the Scarlet Forest. Immaculate insect specimens sleep in this amber, red as fine liquor.

items.name: Eternal Scarlet Amber
items.description: Colossal amber from the Scarlet Forest. Ancient life has been sealed away inside it for eons.

items.name: Queensbloom Pollen
items.description: Pollen from a giant flower in the Scarlet Forest, as regal as it is massive. Makes a heady perfume.

items.name: Shiny Treasure
items.description: An ancient artifact Wudwuds found in the Scarlet Forest. Purely aesthetic in nature.

items.name: Sparkly Treasure
items.description: A rarity of the Scarlet Forest. The fine detail and lavish use of gold show quite advanced techniques.

items.name: Bulky Treasure
items.description: The sheer scale of this Scarlet Forest rarity makes it the object of obsession for all Wudwuds.

items.name: Auric Oil
items.description: Exceptionally pure, golden mineral oil from Oilwell Basin. Used widely in Flameborn crafts.

items.name: Antimite
items.description: A mineral from Oilwell Basin with a unique sheen. Used by the Flameborn in alloy production.

items.name: Fine Antimite
items.description: An Oilwell Basin rarity too pure to be worked by any but the Flameborn artisans.

items.name: Antimite Mass
items.description: A hulking antimite formation that produces strange reactions not yet understood by science.

items.name: Hirabami Molting
items.description: Skin shed from a Hirabami. Treasured by the people of the Iceshard Cliffs as a curative.

items.name: Wyvernscale Vase
items.description: An ancient ornamental vase found in the Iceshard Cliffs. The techniques used to craft it are lost to time.

items.name: Dragonscale Vase
items.description: Each individual scale ornamenting this vase from the Iceshard Cliffs sparkles with a fiery brilliance.

items.name: Large Goldenscale Vase
items.description: An exquisite, inscribed vase from the Iceshard Cliffs. A treasure worthy of kings, lost to the world.

items.name: Wyveria Lantern
items.description: Fruit encased in a mesh shell, found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A precious source of sustenance to the natives.

items.name: Mature Wyveria Lantern
items.description: A rarity in the Ruins of Wyveria. The ripening process imbues the fruit with medicinal properties.

items.name: Origin Wylk Gem
items.description: A precious find from the Ruins of Wyveria. More transparent than other Wylkdrops and has considerable heft.

items.name: Milky Cocoon Web
items.description: A curious fiber found in the Ruins of Wyveria. A resource treasured by the Keepers.

items.name: Wylk Pebble
items.description: Small stones found across the East. A rich source of energy, they are often burned for fuel.

items.name: Wylk Gem
items.description: A beautiful, faintly luminescent stone occasionally found inside Wylkdrops harvested in the East.

items.name: Seregios Dissenter
items.description: A single scale that points defiantly in a different direction from its brethren.

items.name: Lagiacrus Hide+
items.description: A fine hide taken from a Lagiacrus. It's quite strong and immensely flexible.

items.name: Lagiacrus Shockspike
items.description: The spike from a Lagiacrus's back. Safe to handle since it's used to release electricity, not generate it.
